findings.summary: Terms are used inconsistently: Page 1 says a different @MockBean set builds a new context, while Page 2 teaches @MockitoBean as the current annotation.
findings.evidence: Page 1: "A different @MockBean set, properties or profiles builds a new one"; Page 6: "Each distinct @MockBean or property set = new cached context" vs Page 2: "@MockitoBean (Boot 3.4+; @MockBean deprecated before it)"
findings.fix: Use @MockitoBean (note @MockBean on older Boot) consistently on pages 1 and 6.

findings.summary: The text says @MockBean was deprecated before @MockitoBean arrived in Boot 3.4, but @MockBean was deprecated in 3.4 itself, when @MockitoBean was introduced.
findings.evidence: Supply dependencies with @MockitoBean (Boot 3.4+; @MockBean deprecated before it)
findings.fix: Write: Supply dependencies with @MockitoBean (Boot 3.4+, which also deprecates @MockBean). On older Boot versions, use @MockBean.

findings.summary: MockMvc code block is shown after the flow but the POST snippet is merged into the GET snippet with no stated idea before it.
findings.fix: Put a one-line idea before each snippet (e.g. 'GET: assert status and JSON field', 'POST: set contentType') and separate the two examples.

findings.summary: One bullet holds two ideas: the MockitoBean version note and the replacement of the deprecated annotation.
findings.evidence: Supply dependencies with @MockitoBean (Boot 3.4+; @MockBean deprecated before it)
findings.fix: Split into 'Supply dependencies with @MockitoBean' and 'Boot 3.4+: @MockitoBean replaces deprecated @MockBean'.

findings.summary: Code is shown before the idea is stated, and the fallback snippet has only a trailing label.
findings.fix: State 'Container + @ServiceConnection wires the datasource' before the first block and 'Pre-3.1 fallback: @DynamicPropertySource' before the second.

findings.summary: The section does not cover an outline point (missing "concatenation", "placeholders").
findings.evidence: Logging: Logback is the default via SLF4J; set logging.level.com.acme=DEBUG, logging.file.name=app.log, logging.pattern.console; prefer SLF4J logger with {} placeholders over string concatenation
findings.fix: Add the point with an explanation and an example.

findings.summary: The config precedence list is shown as an unlabeled stack and mixes levels, so ordering and the 'highest/lowest' direction is easy to misread; it also omits env vars placement relative to profile files in the label.
findings.evidence:
Command-line args (highest)
SPRING_APPLICATION_JSON
OS env vars
application-{profile}.yml
application.yml
@PropertySource
Defaults (lowest)
findings.fix: Render as a numbered 1-7 ranked list or a labeled top-to-bottom diagram with 'wins' and 'loses' ends.

findings.summary: The Actuator endpoint table mixes unrelated rows and puts a security warning in the 'Use' cell as a row.
findings.fix: Move the warning to a separate callout and describe what /env and /heapdump do.

findings.summary: The Dockerfile build/runtime flow is given as fragmented labels with no clear sequence, and the ENTRYPOINT line is shown before the multi-stage idea.

Build stage

findings.summary: A bash block mixes a properties setting with a curl command, so the block is mislabeled and not scannable.
findings.evidence:
bash
management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,prometheus
logging.level.root=INFO

findings.fix: Put the properties in a properties/yaml block and the curl in a separate bash block, each with a one-line lead-in.
